proves.claim: With gate.runnersOnly on or a registered runner, the check baseline after add or edit is queued as a runner job and starts no local runner or worker on the board machine.

lib.io-check-baseline.runners-only-queue.why: Without it, a baseline that starts a committed-runner controller on the board machine for every add or edit would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With runners off, every baseline is a queued board job for the one local runner, and no add starts a detached worker beside it.

lib.io-check-baseline.one-local-baseline.why: Without it, a wave of adds that starts one local baseline worker per add would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A baseline launched as a runner job still records its green or red result, command, main, request and seconds on the item.

lib.io-check-baseline.runner-job-records.why: Without it, a runner-job baseline whose pass or fail never reaches the item would pass unnoticed.
